# AuraWave — Complete Step-by-Step Running Guide

1. Extract `AuraWave-Portable-Windows-x64.zip` to `C:\Users\<YOUR_USERNAME>\Applications\AuraWave\`.
2. Open the extracted folder and double-click `AuraWave.exe` (or `Launch-AuraWave.bat`).
3. Start playing music in Brave, Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Spotify.
4. Use `Alt + S` to open Settings, `Alt + C` to toggle click-through, `Ctrl + Alt + E` to enter Edit Mode, and `Alt + Q` to quit cleanly.
